purpose: Generate a new non-publishable c64 control oracle with an admission window longer than the measured 451 ms request-arrival split.

prior_result.conclusion: 50 ms did not form one stable c64 admission cohort.

pilot_policy: PILOT_MODE=1. Aggregate throughput and comparison-oracle match count are diagnostic only and never publishable. The run may generate a new c64 oracle only if all 64 responses are complete, cache counts are zero, token-ID isolation is complete, collisions are zero, WDC is absent, and kernel/server gates are clean.
next_gate: Freeze the new c64 oracle hash, then preregister two fresh strict replays at the identical 750 ms shape. Any replay below 64/64 rejects this scheduler approach.
